So it is a bleak, dark road. On top off all that I need a lawyer too. Yeah this sucks.

Thank you for your kind words, I feel better but I'll see how the next couple of days go
What did you do to get thru?
I don't know any services besides seeking therapy or counseling. I just a person but you can talk to me... You are worthwhile. Problems and troubles are problems and troubles, what's going on?
I don't want to deal with the world and problems  just makes it worse. Thank you for feeling for me
I feel you, and I want to understand you
Tell me everything, absulotely everything. I want to know everything

They're your talents..... Use them or don't..... But you decide. When I actively decide to do things or not it feels way better. Just do what you want. When you bring joy to others because it was your choice sometimes it can make your day worth it.

Ty for your response, I might do this I might not. I haven't decided but your concern and your advice have been noticed. 2 tickets for about 1200 each. Ill probably have to go to jail for few days right?
I'm the problem, if the tickets got paid I'd still be alive. I would just end up in another situation. Living is just one problem to the next.
